scripts.script:
local image = "130458123729086"
local sound = "6018028320"
local seconds = 10

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local tool
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RequestCommand = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("HDAdminHDClient").Signals.RequestCommandSilent
RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";music ".. sound)

for i,v in player:GetDescendants() do
	if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent end
end

if not tool then
	for i,v in game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants() do
		if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then tool = v.Parent end
	end
end

local remote = tool.SyncAPI.ServerEndpoint

function fireRemote(args)
	remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
end

for _, targetPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(function()
		local targetCamCF = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local spawnCF = targetCamCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
		
		fireRemote({"CreatePart", "Normal", spawnCF, workspace})

		local p
		local children = workspace:GetChildren()
		for i = #children, 1, -1 do
			if children[i].Name == "Part" and (children[i].Position - spawnCF.p).Magnitude < 5 then
				p = children[i]
				break
			end
		end

		if p then
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.CastShadow = true
			
			fireRemote({"SetName", {p}, "Jumpscare" .. targetPlayer.Name})
			fireRemote({"SyncMaterial", {{["Part"] = p, ["Transparency"] = 1}}})
			fireRemote({"SyncResize", {{["Part"] = p, ["CFrame"] = p.CFrame, ["Size"] = Vector3.new(6.3, 3, 0.1)}}})
			fireRemote({"SetLocked", {p}, true})
			
			fireRemote({"CreateTextures", {{["Part"] = p, ["Face"] = Enum.NormalId.Front, ["TextureType"] = "Decal"}}})
			fireRemote({"SyncTexture", {{["Part"] = p, ["Face"] = Enum.NormalId.Front, ["TextureType"] = "Decal", ["Texture"] = "rbxassetid://"..image}}})
			
			local connection
			local startTime = tick()

			connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if tick() - startTime > seconds then
					connection:Disconnect()
					fireRemote({"Remove", {p}})
					RequestCommand:InvokeServer(";unmusic")
					return
				end
				
				if p and p.Parent then
					local followCF = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180), 0, math.rad(-180))
					fireRemote({"SyncMove", {{["Part"] = p, ["CFrame"] = followCF}}})
				else
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

scripts.title: Retro X's OLD chase theme
scripts.script:
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local originalRage = nil

local function loadCustomAsset(url, filename)
	if not isfile(filename) then
		writefile(filename, game:HttpGet(url))
	end
	return getcustomasset(filename)
end

local RETROXCHASE = loadCustomAsset(
	"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MisterSaiyan/cosas/main/RetroXOLDCHASE.mp3",
	"RetroXOLDCHASE.mp3"
)

task.spawn(function()
	local theme = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	:FindFirstChild("ClientAssets")
	and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets:FindFirstChild("Sounds")
	and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds:FindFirstChild("mus")
	and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus:FindFirstChild("Game")
	and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game:FindFirstChild("Round")
	and game.ReplicatedStorage.ClientAssets.Sounds.mus.Game.Round:FindFirstChild("ChaseThemes")
    :FindFirstChild("2011x")
    :FindFirstChild("RETRO")
    :FindFirstChild("NormalChase")
	if not theme then
		warn("burps")
		return
	end
	theme.SoundId = RETROXCHASE
	theme.Volume = 1.5
	theme.Looped = false
end)

scripts.title: All In One Features
scripts.features:
Vehicle & Movement Modifications

Spawn Car Anywhere: Allows players to summon vehicles at any location on the map, bypassing normal spawn points.

Car Speed & Fly: Modifies vehicle performance, including speed boosts and the ability to make cars fly.

Fly & NoClip: Enables the player to fly freely around the map or pass through solid objects (NoClip).

Infinite Jump: Removes the standard limit on jumps, allowing for continuous jumping.

Teleportation (TP): Provides instant travel options, such as teleporting to the center of the map, to specific players, or out of the map boundaries.

Player & Admin Controls

Admin Commands: Grants access to a panel of administrative functions, often including player moderation and management tools.

Kill Aura: Automatically eliminates other players within a certain radius without direct input.

Fling & Bring Players: Allows the user to launch other players (Fling) or forcibly teleport them to the user's location (Bring).

Invisibility & Anti-AFK: Toggles the player's visibility to others and prevents the game from kicking the player for being idle.

Visual & Aesthetic Changes

ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): Displays visual overlays that reveal the location of other players or items through walls.

Custom Effects: Enables cosmetic changes like Rainbow Effects, Neon Effects, or a "Big Head" mode.

Skybox Replacement: In more disruptive exploits, the game's sky can be replaced with custom images, as seen in incidents where the skybox was changed to a "Shrek" character.

Automation & Utility

Auto-Farm: Automates repetitive tasks, such as earning in-game currency, to save time.

Premium Item Unlocking: Allows players to obtain items that are normally locked behind a paywall or premium currency.
